content: N burɑm bo ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑro kpɑ ɑ n sĩimɔ dee dee, ye kɑɑ n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ kpɑ ɑ n weesu mɔ̀.
Hɑniɑ yɛ̃ru sɑriru sɔɔ, yɑ ǹ ɑrufɑɑni mɔ. Sɛndɑru tɑ rɑ kɑ torɑ dɑbinu nɛwɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ tɔnu u wɑ̃ɑ wɑhɑlɑ sɔɔ win ɡɑri bɑkɑrun sɔ̃, Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ kɑ mɔru ko.
Gobiɡiin bɔrɔbɑ bɑ rɑ n dɑbiru sosimɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ sɑ̃ɑro, bɔrɔ turo wi u mɔ, u rɑ n mɑm kĩ u nùn deriwɑ.
Bɑ koo seedɑ weesuɡiɑn dio sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ kɑm kɑm. U ǹ kisirɑmɔ.
Bɑɑwure u rɑ n kɑsuwɑ u dɑmɡii fufu ko. Bɑɑwure u rɑ n mɑɑ kĩwɑ u n sɑ̃ɑ wi u rɑ kɛ̃nu wɛ̃n bɔrɔ.
Sɑ̃ɑron mɛro bisibu bɑ rɑ nùn yinɛwɑ. Kɑɑ sere ɡere win bɔrɔbɑ? Bɑɑ ù n kɑsu u kɑ ɡoo ɡɑri ko, u ku rɑ wɑ.
Wi u rɑ bwisiku u sere ɡɑ̃ɑnu ko, win hunden ɑlɑfiɑwɑ u kɑsu. Wi u mɑɑ bwisi kɑsu, doo nɔɔrɑ yi koo kɑ nùn nɑɑwɑ.
Bɑ koo seedɑ weesuɡiɑn diobu sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ kɑm kɑm, kpɑ ben weesu su bu kɑm ko.
N ǹ weenɛ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u n wɑ̃ɑ doo nɔɔru sɔɔ. Kɑɑ sere ɡere yoo u n sinɑmbu kpɑre?
Tɔnu wi u bwisi mɔ, u rɑ win mɔru nɛnɛwɑ. U rɑ torɑ ni bɑ nùn kuɑ duɑriwɑ win bɛɛrɛn sɔ̃.
Sunɔn mɔru yɑ̀ n seewɑ, yɑ rɑ n nɑnum mɔwɑ nɡe ɡbee sunɔn kukiribu, kpɑ win durom mu n ɑrufɑɑni mɔ nɡe kɑkoru yɑkɑsu wɔllɔ.
Bii ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ kɑ win tundo nɔni swɑ̃ɑru nɑɑwɛwɑ. Tɔn kurɔ nɔɔ ɡɔmunuɡiin sɑnnɔsu ku rɑ kpe nɡe nim mɛ mu dɑ̃ɑkumɔ.
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ yɛnu kɑ dukiɑ tubi di, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ tɔnu kurɔ lɑɑkɑriɡii wɛ̃.
Yikuru tɑ rɑ tɔnu dom kpɛ̃ɛwɑ. Wi u ku rɑ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ko, u ǹ ɡɔ̃ɔru biɑmɔ.
Wi u Gusunɔn woodɑ nɛni, u win wɑ̃ɑru kɔ̃suwɑ. Wi u kun win sɑnu sɑnusu lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑ u koo ɡbiwɑ.
Wi u sɑ̃ɑro kɛ̃ru wɛ̃ɛmɔ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u bɔkurɑmɔ. U koo mɑɑ yɛ̃ro nùn win nuku tiɑn ɑre wɛ̃.
A wunɛn bii sɛɛyɑsio sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ yɛ̃ yɑ koo nùn somi, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ ku nùn so ɑ ɡo.
Wi u kɑ mɔru ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɑnkɑ, u koo yen kɔsire wɛ̃wɑ. Wi u kun nùn kɔsire ye bikie, u nùn dɑm kɛ̃mɔwɑ u kɑ wure u ko.
A bwisi swɑɑ dɑkio, ɑ de bu nun yi keu ko, kpɑ ɑ ko bwisiɡii wunɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ɔ ni nu tie sɔɔ.
Tɔnu u rɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu niɑ ko, ɑdɑmɑ Gusunɔn himbɑ tɔnɑwɑ yɑ rɑ koore.
Mɛ bɑ rɑ n kĩ tɔnu u n sɑ̃ɑ, yerɑ u n sɑ̃ɑ nɑɑnɛɡii. N burɑm bo ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑro, ye kɑɑ n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ weesuɡii.
Wi u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie, u ko n wɑ̃ɑru mɔ, kpɑ win wɑ̃ɑ te, tɑ n deburu mɔ. U ǹ mɑɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru ɡɑru wɑsi.
Gɑbu bɑ yikuru mɔ sere bɑ̀ n dĩɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛru nɔmɑ kpɛ̃ɛ, bɑ ku rɑ mɑɑ kpĩ bu ye wunɑ bu kɑ dɑ nɔɔwɔ.
A tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio soowo kpɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u bwisi ko.
A bwisiɡii ɡerusio, kpɑ u ɡiɑ ye ɑ kĩ ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔsi.
Nɛn bii, ɑ̀ n sɔ̃ɔsiru biru kisi, wunɛn yɛ̃ru tɑ koo kpe.
Seedɑ weesuɡiɑn dio u rɑ ɡem yɑɑkoru kowɑ. Kɔ̃sɑn kĩrɑ tɑ rɑ n tɔn kɔ̃so nɛni.
Tii suo u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑbun kɑri sɔɔ. Gɑri bɔkɔ u ku rɑ mɑɑ soberu bie.
